translations.text: Christ's cross across this face, across this ear in this way. Christ's cross across this eye. Christ's cross across this nose.
Christ's cross across this mouth. Christ's cross across this throat. Christ's cross across this back. Christ's cross across this side.
Christ's cross across this belly (this is how it is fitting). Christ's cross across this lower belly. Christ's cross across this back.
Christ's cross over my arms, from my shoulders to my palms. Christ's cross over my thighs. Christ's cross over my legs.
Christ's cross with me before me. Christ's cross with me behind me. Christ's cross against every hardship, whether on slope or on hill.
Christ's cross eastward, toward my face; Christ's cross westward, toward the sunset. South and north, without any pause, Christ's cross without any delay.
Christ's cross over my teeth, so that neither injury nor harm may come to me. Christ's cross over my stomach. Christ's cross over my heart.
Christ's cross up toward heaven. Christ's cross down toward the earth. Let no evil or harm come to my body or to my soul.
Christ's cross over my sitting. Christ's cross over my lying down. Christ's cross is all my strength, until we reach the King of heaven.
Christ's cross over my community. Christ's cross over my church. Christ's cross in the world beyond. Christ's cross in this world.
From the top of my head to the nail of my foot, O Christ, against every danger, under the protection of your cross.
Until the day of my death, before I go into this earth, without (reluctance [?]) I will make Christ's cross over this face.
